title: Spiced Chickpea Avocado Bowl
description: A protein-rich vegan bowl with spiced chickpeas and creamy avocado. Great for fat loss and general health.
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas, then dry-roast in a pan with cumin and paprika for 5 minutes.
Slice avocado and arrange in a bowl.
Add roasted chickpeas on top and drizzle with lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper and serve immediately.

title: Greek Yogurt Berry Parfait
description: A creamy vegetarian breakfast parfait layered with Greek yogurt and fresh berries. Packed with protein and antioxidants.
instructions: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl or glass.
Add a layer of fresh berries on top.
Sprinkle chia seeds and a drizzle of honey.
Serve immediately or refrigerate overnight.

title: Scrambled Eggs Whole Wheat Toast
description: Classic scrambled eggs on whole wheat toast providing quality protein and complex carbs. Ideal for busy mornings.
instructions: Whisk eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of butter and add eggs.
Stir gently over medium-low heat until just set.
Toast whole wheat bread and serve eggs on top.

title: Turkey Spinach Breakfast Wrap
description: A lean turkey and spinach wrap delivering high protein and essential vitamins. Perfect for active mornings.
instructions: Cook sliced turkey breast in a pan with olive oil until cooked through.
Warm the whole wheat wrap briefly in the pan.
Layer spinach and turkey on the wrap.
Roll tightly and serve with salsa or hot sauce.

title: Smoked Salmon Cucumber Bites
description: Light and elegant smoked salmon on cucumber slices with cream cheese. Rich in omega-3 fatty acids.
instructions: Slice cucumber into thick rounds.
Top each round with a small amount of cottage cheese.
Lay a piece of smoked salmon on top.
Garnish with lemon juice and fresh dill.

title: Mango Chia Overnight Oats
description: A vibrant vegan overnight oat bowl with mango and chia seeds. High in fiber and natural sugars for morning energy.
instructions: Combine oats, chia seeds, and plant-based milk in a jar.
Stir well and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, top with diced mango.
Add a drizzle of maple syrup if desired and serve.

title: Paneer Bhurji Roti
description: A hearty Indian vegetarian breakfast of scrambled paneer with spices served with roti. Protein-dense and filling.
instructions: Crumble paneer and set aside.
Saute onion, tomato, and green chili in olive oil.
Add crumbled paneer with turmeric, cumin, and salt.
Cook for 5 minutes and serve with warm roti.

title: Chicken Omelette with Veggies
description: A protein-packed chicken and vegetable omelette ideal for muscle building. Quick and satisfying breakfast.
instructions: Dice cooked chicken breast and set aside.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Pour eggs into a hot oiled pan and add chicken, bell pepper, and mushrooms.
Fold omelette in half and serve hot.

title: Shrimp Avocado Egg Scramble
description: A luxurious breakfast combining shrimp, eggs, and creamy avocado. Rich in protein and healthy fats.
instructions: Saute shrimp in olive oil until pink and set aside.
Scramble eggs in the same pan.
Combine shrimp and eggs, season with salt and chili flakes.
Top with sliced avocado and serve.

title: Banana Oat Smoothie Bowl
description: A creamy vegan smoothie bowl with banana and oats for sustained energy. Rich in potassium and complex carbs.
instructions: Blend banana with oats and almond milk until smooth.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with sliced banana, almonds, and chia seeds.
Serve immediately.

title: Cottage Cheese Veggie Breakfast Bowl
description: A protein-rich vegetarian bowl with cottage cheese and fresh vegetables. Low calorie and high satiety.
instructions: Scoop cottage cheese into a bowl.
Add diced cucumber, tomato, and bell pepper.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh herbs.
Drizzle lemon juice and serve immediately.

title: Tuna Egg White Breakfast Skillet
description: A high-protein tuna and egg white skillet for lean muscle building. Low fat and packed with amino acids.
instructions: Drain canned tuna and flake it into a pan.
Add egg whites and cook over medium heat, stirring.
Season with garlic, chili flakes, and salt.
Add spinach and cook until wilted, then serve.

title: Ground Beef Sweet Potato Hash
description: A hearty breakfast hash with lean ground beef and sweet potato. Loaded with protein and complex carbs for sustained energy.
instructions: Dice sweet potato and pan-fry in olive oil for 10 minutes until tender.
Add ground beef and cook through, breaking it apart.
Season with paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Top with a fried egg if desired and serve hot.

title: Quinoa Almond Breakfast Bowl
description: A nutrient-dense vegan breakfast bowl with quinoa, almonds, and banana. High in complete protein and healthy fats.
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
Let cool slightly and transfer to a bowl.
Top with sliced banana, almonds, and chia seeds.
Drizzle with maple syrup and serve warm.

title: Spinach Feta Egg Muffins
description: Baked egg muffins with spinach and feta cheese. A portable, protein-rich vegetarian breakfast.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180C and grease a muffin tin.
Whisk eggs with salt, pepper, and chopped spinach.
Pour into muffin cups and top with crumbled feta.
Bake for 18-20 minutes until set and serve.

title: Salmon Cream Cheese Bagel
description: A classic high-protein breakfast with salmon and cream cheese on a whole wheat base. Rich in omega-3s.
instructions: Toast whole wheat bread until golden.
Spread cottage cheese or cream cheese on toast.
Layer smoked salmon on top.
Garnish with cucumber slices and lemon juice.

title: Beef Egg Fried Rice Breakfast
description: A filling Asian-inspired breakfast with ground beef, eggs, and brown rice. Great for weight training days.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok and cook ground beef until browned.
Push beef to side, add eggs and scramble.
Add cooked brown rice and stir-fry everything together.
Season with soy sauce, garlic, and serve hot.

title: Tempeh Veggie Breakfast Hash
description: A smoky vegan hash with tempeh and colorful vegetables. High in plant protein and fiber.
instructions: Dice tempeh into small cubes and pan-fry in olive oil until golden.
Add diced bell pepper, onion, and mushrooms.
Season with smoked paprika, cumin, and salt.
Cook until vegetables are tender and serve hot.

title: Oat Banana Peanut Butter Bowl
description: A hearty vegan breakfast bowl with oats, banana, and peanut butter. Calorie-dense and great for endurance athletes.
instructions: Cook oats with water or plant milk until creamy.
Stir in peanut butter until melted and combined.
Top with sliced banana and walnuts.
Serve warm with a drizzle of maple syrup.

title: Paneer Paratha Breakfast
description: A classic Indian breakfast with stuffed paneer paratha. Rich in protein and complex carbs for sustained energy.
instructions: Mix flour with water to make roti dough and rest for 10 minutes.
Crumble paneer with spices for the filling.
Roll out dough, stuff with paneer, seal, and roll again.
Cook on a hot griddle with butter until golden on both sides.

title: Chicken Avocado Breakfast Bowl
description: A power breakfast bowl with grilled chicken, avocado, and eggs. High protein and healthy fats for muscle gain.
instructions: Grill or pan-cook chicken breast with olive oil and seasoning.
Slice chicken and arrange in a bowl.
Add sliced avocado and a poached or fried egg.
Season with salt, pepper, and hot sauce.

title: Salmon Sweet Potato Breakfast Bowl
description: A nutritious bowl combining omega-3-rich salmon with sweet potato. Great for endurance and recovery.
instructions: Roast diced sweet potato in olive oil at 200C for 15 minutes.
Pan-sear salmon fillet for 4 minutes per side.
Flake salmon and serve over sweet potato.
Add spinach and drizzle with lemon.

title: Black Bean Avocado Toast
description: A filling vegan toast with spiced black beans and avocado. Packed with fiber and plant protein.
instructions: Toast whole wheat bread until golden.
Mash avocado with lime juice and salt.
Warm black beans with cumin and chili powder.
Spread avocado on toast and top with black beans.

title: Tofu Spinach Scramble
description: A vegan alternative to scrambled eggs using crumbled tofu and spinach. High in plant protein and iron.
instructions: Crumble firm tofu into a pan and cook on medium heat.
Add turmeric, black pepper, and salt for color and flavor.
Fold in spinach and cook until wilted.
Serve hot on its own or with toast.

title: Moong Dal Cheela
description: A traditional Indian vegan pancake made from moong dal batter. Light, high-protein, and easily digestible.
instructions: Blend soaked moong dal with ginger, green chili, and water to a smooth batter.
Heat a non-stick pan and pour a ladle of batter.
Spread in a circle and cook on medium heat for 3 minutes each side.
Serve with mint chutney or yogurt.

title: Egg Muffin Cup with Bacon
description: Protein-rich baked egg cups with turkey bacon. A quick grab-and-go high-protein breakfast.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180C.
Line muffin tins with turkey bacon slices.
Crack an egg into each cup and season with salt and pepper.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until egg is set.

title: Prawn Tomato Breakfast SautÃ©
description: A Mediterranean-style prawn and tomato sautÃ© for a light, protein-rich morning meal. Low calorie and full of flavor.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add shrimp and garlic and cook for 3-4 minutes until pink.
Add diced tomatoes and cook for another 3 minutes.
Season with herbs, salt, and pepper and serve.

title: Walnut Date Oat Bowl
description: A calorie-dense vegan breakfast with oats, walnuts, and dates. Excellent for energy loading before workouts.
instructions: Cook oats with water or almond milk until creamy.
Stir in walnuts and chopped dates.
Add chia seeds and a pinch of cinnamon.
Drizzle with almond butter and serve warm.

title: High Protein Vegetarian Breakfast Burrito
description: A filling vegetarian burrito with eggs, beans, and cheese. Complete protein and complex carbs in one wrap.
instructions: Scramble eggs in a pan with olive oil.
Warm black beans with cumin and salt.
Place eggs, beans, and shredded cheese on a warm tortilla.
Roll tightly and serve with salsa.

title: Chicken Quinoa Power Breakfast
description: A calorie-dense power breakfast with grilled chicken and quinoa. Ideal for athletes needing sustained energy and muscle support.
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
Grill chicken breast with olive oil, salt, and herbs.
Slice chicken and serve over quinoa with spinach.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve.

title: Lentil Vegetable Soup
description: A hearty vegan lentil soup with mixed vegetables. Rich in plant protein, fiber, and iron for fat loss.
instructions: Saute onion, garlic, and carrot in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add red lentils and diced tomatoes and stir.
Pour in vegetable stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with cumin, turmeric, and salt and serve hot.

title: Caprese Salad with Quinoa
description: A Mediterranean vegetarian lunch with fresh mozzarella, tomatoes, and quinoa. Light and refreshing with good protein.
instructions: Cook quinoa and let it cool.
Slice mozzarella and tomatoes.
Combine quinoa, mozzarella, and tomatoes in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and garnish with fresh basil.

title: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Classic grilled chicken Caesar salad with romaine and low-fat dressing. High protein and low calorie.
instructions: Season chicken breast and grill for 6-7 minutes per side.
Slice chicken and let rest.
Toss romaine with cottage cheese dressing and lemon.
Top with sliced chicken and serve.

title: Tuna Nicoise Salad
description: A classic French Nicoise salad with tuna and vegetables. Packed with protein and essential nutrients.
instructions: Boil eggs for 8 minutes and cool.
Drain tuna and arrange on a plate with cucumber and tomato.
Halve the boiled eggs and add to the plate.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon dressing.

title: Beef Lettuce Wrap
description: Low-carb Asian-style ground beef lettuce wraps. A lean, protein-rich meal with vibrant flavor.
instructions: Cook ground beef in a pan with garlic and ginger until browned.
Season with soy sauce, sesame oil, and chili flakes.
Spoon mixture into large lettuce leaves.
Top with diced carrot and serve immediately.

title: Chickpea Salad Wrap
description: A hearty vegan wrap with spiced chickpeas and fresh vegetables. High in fiber and plant protein.
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas and mash lightly.
Mix with diced cucumber, tomato, onion, and lemon juice.
Season with cumin, coriander, and salt.
Spread onto a whole wheat wrap and roll up.

title: Paneer Tikka Salad
description: A flavorful Indian vegetarian salad with grilled paneer tikka. High in protein and perfect for midday meals.
instructions: Marinate paneer cubes in yogurt, turmeric, and garam masala for 10 minutes.
Grill or pan-cook paneer until lightly charred.
Arrange over a bed of spinach and cucumber.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve.

title: Cod Zucchini Bake
description: A light and protein-rich baked cod with zucchini. Low calorie and ideal for fat loss goals.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C.
Place cod fillet on a baking tray with sliced zucchini.
Drizzle with olive oil, garlic, and lemon juice.
Bake for 18-20 minutes and serve hot.

title: Lamb Keema Roti Bowl
description: A hearty Indian-style minced lamb keema served with roti. Rich in protein and iron for strength training.
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil until golden.
Add ground lamb with spices and cook until browned.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with warm roti.

title: Tofu Brown Rice Stir Fry
description: A simple vegan stir fry with tofu and brown rice. Provides complete plant protein and sustained energy.
instructions: Press and cube tofu, then pan-fry until golden.
Add broccoli, bell pepper, and garlic to the pan.
Stir fry for 5 minutes and add cooked brown rice.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil, then serve.

title: Dal Makhani Brown Rice
description: A rich Indian vegetarian black lentil dal served with brown rice. High in protein and complex carbs.
instructions: Pressure cook lentils until soft.
Saute onion, garlic, and tomato in butter.
Add cooked lentils with spices and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve over brown rice.

title: Turkey Meatball Zucchini Noodles
description: Lean turkey meatballs with zucchini noodles and tomato sauce. Low carb, high protein for body recomposition.
instructions: Mix ground turkey with garlic, salt, and pepper and form small balls.
Pan-cook meatballs until browned and cooked through.
Spiralize zucchini and saute briefly.
Serve meatballs over zucchini noodles with tomato sauce.

title: Prawn Coconut Curry
description: A fragrant prawn curry with coconut milk. Rich in protein and healthy fats from coconut.
instructions: Saute onion, garlic, and ginger in coconut oil.
Add curry paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add shrimp and coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve over brown rice.

title: Soy Chunk Palak Rice
description: An Indian-style vegan soy chunk and spinach rice bowl. Excellent plant protein with iron-rich greens.
instructions: Soak soy chunks in hot water for 10 minutes, then squeeze dry.
Saute onion and spices, add soy chunks and spinach.
Add cooked rice and stir fry together.
Season with salt and cumin and serve hot.

title: Chicken Breast Sweet Potato Curry
description: A nourishing chicken and sweet potato curry with warming spices. Packed with protein, beta-carotene, and complex carbs.
instructions: Cube chicken breast and brown in olive oil.
Add diced sweet potato and onion and stir.
Add curry paste, tomatoes, and water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve as a standalone bowl or with rice.

title: Salmon Miso Broccoli Bowl
description: A Japanese-inspired salmon and broccoli bowl with miso. High in omega-3s and cruciferous vegetables.
instructions: Marinate salmon in miso paste and sesame oil for 10 minutes.
Bake salmon at 200C for 15 minutes.
Steam broccoli until tender-crisp.
Serve salmon over brown rice with broccoli.

title: Black Bean Sweet Potato Tacos
description: Flavorful vegan tacos with black beans and roasted sweet potato. High in fiber and plant protein.
instructions: Roast diced sweet potato with cumin and chili powder at 200C.
Warm black beans with smoked paprika and salt.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with sweet potato, black beans, and avocado.

title: Egg Paneer Curry
description: A rich Indian curry combining boiled eggs and paneer in a spiced tomato gravy. Dual-protein vegetarian feast.
instructions: Boil eggs and halve them.
Saute onion, garlic, and tomato in oil with spices.
Add paneer cubes and boiled eggs.
Simmer for 10 minutes and serve with rice or roti.

title: Beef Stir Fry with Vegetables
description: A quick Asian-style beef stir fry with colorful vegetables. High in protein and iron for strength athletes.
instructions: Slice beef thinly and marinate in soy sauce and ginger.
Stir fry beef in a hot wok for 3-4 minutes.
Add broccoli, bell pepper, and mushrooms and stir fry 4 more minutes.
Serve over brown rice or noodles.

title: Kidney Bean Quinoa Power Bowl
description: A vegan power bowl with kidney beans, quinoa, and avocado. Complete protein and healthy fats for endurance.
instructions: Cook quinoa and set aside.
Warm kidney beans with cumin, smoked paprika, and salt.
Assemble bowl with quinoa, kidney beans, and sliced avocado.
Drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil.

title: Mozzarella Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Roasted bell peppers stuffed with quinoa and mozzarella. A satisfying vegetarian lunch with balanced macros.
instructions: Halve bell peppers and remove seeds.
Mix cooked quinoa with diced tomatoes and herbs.
Fill peppers with quinoa mixture and top with mozzarella.
Bake at 200C for 20 minutes until cheese is golden.

title: Grilled Shrimp Quinoa Bowl
description: A lean protein bowl with grilled shrimp and quinoa. Low calorie, high protein, and packed with nutrients.
instructions: Season shrimp with garlic, paprika, and lemon.
Grill shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side.
Cook quinoa and let cool.
Serve shrimp over quinoa with cucumber and tomato.

title: Tempeh Millet Power Bowl
description: A vegan power bowl with tempeh, millet, and roasted vegetables. Dense in plant protein and complex carbs.
instructions: Cook millet according to package instructions.
Pan-fry tempeh slices until golden on both sides.
Roast broccoli and bell pepper with olive oil at 200C.
Assemble bowl with millet, tempeh, and roasted vegetables.

title: Spinach Ricotta Stuffed Chicken
description: Juicy chicken breast stuffed with spinach and ricotta. An impressive high-protein Italian-style dinner.
instructions: Butterfly chicken breast and season inside.
Mix cottage cheese with wilted spinach and stuff chicken.
Seal with toothpicks and sear in an oven-proof pan.
Bake at 190C for 20 minutes and rest before serving.

title: Beef Barley Vegetable Stew
description: A slow-cooked beef and barley stew with root vegetables. A hearty, calorie-dense meal for serious athletes.
instructions: Brown ground beef in a pot with onion and garlic.
Add barley, carrots, and beef stock.
Simmer covered for 35 minutes until barley is tender.
Season with salt, thyme, and black pepper.

title: Chickpea Coconut Spinach Curry
description: A creamy vegan chickpea curry with coconut milk and spinach. Iron-rich and satisfying for dinner.
instructions: Saute onion, garlic, and ginger in coconut oil.
Add curry powder and canned chickpeas, stir well.
Pour in coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add spinach, cook until wilted, and serve with rice.

title: Baked Cod with Quinoa Pilaf
description: A light Mediterranean baked cod served with herb quinoa. Clean protein and complex carbs for lean muscle.
instructions: Cook quinoa with herbs and season.
Season cod fillet with lemon zest, garlic, and olive oil.
Bake cod at 200C for 18 minutes.
Serve cod over quinoa with a lemon wedge.

title: Soy Chunk Mushroom Masala
description: A protein-packed vegan soy chunk and mushroom masala. Excellent plant-based dinner for muscle support.
instructions: Soak soy chunks in hot water, drain and press.
Saute onion, ginger, and garlic in oil.
Add mushrooms, soy chunks, and masala spices.
Add tomatoes, simmer 12 minutes, and serve with roti.

title: Almond Butter Apple Slices
description: A simple vegan snack with apple slices and almond butter. Great source of fiber, healthy fats, and natural sugar.
instructions: Core and slice the apple into wedges.
Arrange on a plate.
Spoon almond butter into a dipping bowl.
Serve immediately.

title: Greek Yogurt Honey Walnuts
description: A creamy vegetarian snack of Greek yogurt topped with walnuts and honey. High protein and satisfying.
instructions: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with crushed walnuts.
Drizzle with a small amount of honey.
Serve immediately.

title: Hard Boiled Egg Veggie Plate
description: A simple protein-packed snack with hard-boiled eggs and fresh vegetables. Ideal for fat loss and satiety.
instructions: Boil eggs for 9-10 minutes for hard boiled.
Cool in ice water and peel.
Halve eggs and arrange with sliced cucumber and carrot.
Season with salt and pepper.

title: Tuna Crackers Snack Plate
description: A quick and easy tuna snack on whole wheat crackers. Lean protein for between-meal energy.
instructions: Drain canned tuna and mix with lemon juice and pepper.
Spread tuna onto whole wheat crackers.
Add sliced cucumber or tomato on top.
Serve immediately.

title: Beef Jerky Mixed Nuts
description: A portable high-protein snack of beef jerky and mixed nuts. Great for on-the-go muscle recovery.
instructions: Portion beef jerky onto a small plate.
Add a handful of mixed nuts alongside.
Optionally add some dried berries for flavor.
Serve as is.

title: Hummus Veggie Sticks
description: A classic vegan snack of homemade hummus with fresh veggie sticks. Rich in plant protein and fiber.
instructions: Blend chickpeas with lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil until smooth.
Season with salt and cumin.
Cut carrot, cucumber, and bell pepper into sticks.
Serve hummus with veggie sticks.

title: Paneer Cumin Snack Skewers
description: Grilled paneer skewers with cumin and herbs. A vegetarian high-protein snack great between meals.
instructions: Cut paneer into cubes and thread onto skewers.
Brush with olive oil and season with cumin, salt, and chili.
Grill or pan-cook until lightly charred.
Serve with mint chutney.

title: Chicken Breast Lettuce Bites
description: Bite-sized chicken breast pieces in lettuce cups. Ultra-lean and high-protein snack for fat loss.
instructions: Dice chicken breast and pan-cook with garlic and soy sauce.
Season with ginger and a touch of sesame oil.
Spoon into large lettuce leaves.
Garnish with diced carrot and serve.

title: Shrimp Avocado Snack Cup
description: Chilled shrimp and avocado in a small cup. A refreshing seafood snack rich in protein and healthy fats.
instructions: Boil shrimp for 3-4 minutes and chill in cold water.
Dice avocado and toss with lemon juice.
Combine shrimp and avocado in a cup.
Season with salt, chili, and serve chilled.

title: Chia Seed Pudding with Berries
description: A creamy vegan chia pudding with fresh berries. High in omega-3s, fiber, and antioxidants.
instructions: Mix chia seeds with coconut milk and stir well.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Top with fresh berries before serving.
Serve chilled.

title: Flaxseed Banana Energy Balls
description: Vegan no-bake energy balls with flaxseeds and banana. A nutrient-dense portable snack for active days.
instructions: Mash banana with oats, flaxseeds, and peanut butter.
Mix until a thick dough forms.
Roll into small balls and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Serve chilled.

title: Cottage Cheese Pineapple Bowl
description: A refreshing vegetarian snack with cottage cheese and pineapple. High protein, low fat combination.
instructions: Scoop cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with diced mango or pineapple.
Sprinkle with a pinch of cinnamon if desired.
Serve immediately.

title: Turkey Roll Ups
description: Simple turkey breast roll-ups with spinach and tomato. A lean, high-protein grab-and-go snack.
instructions: Lay turkey breast slices flat.
Place spinach leaves and sliced tomato on each slice.
Roll up tightly and secure with a toothpick.
Serve immediately or refrigerate.

title: Salmon Cucumber Rounds
description: Smoked salmon on cucumber rounds for a light, omega-3-rich snack. Perfect for any time of day.
instructions: Slice cucumber into thick rounds.
Place a piece of smoked salmon on each round.
Add a squeeze of lemon juice.
Garnish with fresh dill and serve.

title: Peanut Butter Oat Energy Bites
description: Dense vegan no-bake bites with peanut butter, oats, and chia. A calorie-dense snack for athletes.
instructions: Mix oats, peanut butter, chia seeds, and banana in a bowl.
Stir until combined and roll into balls.
Refrigerate for 20 minutes to set.
Serve as a portable snack.

title: Paneer Spinach Snack Patties
description: Mini paneer and spinach patties for a high-protein vegetarian snack. Easy to make and satisfying.
instructions: Grate paneer and mix with finely chopped spinach.
Add spices and form into small patties.
Pan-cook with a small amount of oil until golden on both sides.
Serve with yogurt dip.

title: Chicken Almond Snack Box
description: A meal-prep friendly snack box with chicken bites, almonds, and apple. Balanced macros for sustained energy.
instructions: Dice and season chicken breast and pan-cook until done.
Portion chicken into a container.
Add a portion of almonds and sliced apple alongside.
Seal and refrigerate or serve immediately.

title: Tuna Stuffed Mini Peppers
description: Mini bell peppers stuffed with herbed tuna. A low-carb, high-protein snack bursting with flavor.
instructions: Halve mini bell peppers and remove seeds.
Drain tuna and mix with lemon juice and herbs.
Fill pepper halves with tuna mixture.
Serve immediately.

title: Sunflower Seed Trail Mix
description: A vegan calorie-dense trail mix with sunflower seeds, nuts, and dried fruit. Great for endurance snacking.
instructions: Combine sunflower seeds, almonds, walnuts, and dried berries.
Mix well in a small bag or bowl.
Optionally add dark chocolate chips.
Serve as a portable trail mix.

title: Oat Protein Mug Cake
description: A vegan microwave oat mug cake with banana and peanut butter. High-calorie snack for bulking phases.
instructions: Mash banana in a mug and mix in oats, peanut butter, and a pinch of baking powder.
Add a splash of almond milk and stir until combined.
Microwave for 90 seconds until set.
Let cool briefly and serve.

title: Yogurt Granola Power Snack
description: A filling vegetarian snack bowl with yogurt and granola. Balances protein and carbs for sustained energy.
instructions: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Add oats or granola on top.
Top with sliced banana and berries.
Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Breast Mini Skewers
description: Grilled chicken mini skewers seasoned with herbs. A portable, high-protein non-vegetarian snack.
instructions: Cube chicken breast and thread onto skewers.
Season with olive oil, lemon, garlic, and oregano.
Grill or pan-cook for 6 minutes per side.
Serve with tzatziki or hot sauce.

title: Boiled Egg Spinach Snack Wrap
description: A protein-forward snack wrap with boiled egg and spinach. Easy to prepare and great for meal prep.
instructions: Boil eggs and slice.
Place spinach and sliced eggs on a small whole wheat wrap.
Season with salt, pepper, and a small drizzle of olive oil.
Roll up and serve.

title: Shrimp Cocktail Snack Bowl
description: Classic chilled shrimp cocktail with tomato sauce. Low calorie and high protein seafood snack.
instructions: Cook shrimp in salted water for 3 minutes and chill.
Mix tomato with lemon juice and horseradish for dipping sauce.
Arrange chilled shrimp around the sauce bowl.
Serve immediately.

title: Tempeh Satay Skewers
description: Vegan tempeh satay skewers with peanut dipping sauce. High in plant protein and deeply savory.
instructions: Slice tempeh and marinate in soy sauce and garlic.
Thread onto skewers and grill for 4 minutes per side.
Make peanut dipping sauce with peanut butter and lime juice.
Serve skewers with dipping sauce.

title: Mango Lassi Protein Smoothie
description: A thick vegetarian mango lassi with Greek yogurt. Refreshing, high-protein, and full of vitamins.
instructions: Add mango chunks, Greek yogurt, and low-fat milk to a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Add a pinch of cardamom for flavor.
Serve immediately.

title: Salmon Oat Protein Bar
description: An unconventional but protein-dense non-veg snack combining canned salmon and oats baked into a bar.
instructions: Mix drained salmon with oats, egg, and herbs.
Press into a greased baking tray.
Bake at 180C for 18 minutes until firm.
Cool and slice into bars.

title: Almond Date Energy Bar
description: A calorie-dense vegan energy bar with almonds, dates, and oats. Perfect pre-workout snack.
instructions: Blend almonds, oats, and peanut butter in a food processor.
Add banana and blend until sticky.
Press into a lined tray and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Cut into bars and serve.

title: Beef Boiled Egg Snack Plate
description: A protein-maximized snack plate with boiled eggs and seasoned ground beef. Ideal for weight training recovery.
instructions: Cook ground beef with garlic, salt, and pepper until browned.
Hard boil eggs and halve them.
Arrange beef and eggs on a plate.
Add fresh tomato slices and serve.

title: Lentil Quinoa Dinner Bowl
description: A hearty vegan dinner bowl with lentils and quinoa. High in plant protein and complex carbs for muscle recovery.
instructions: Cook lentils until tender and set aside.
Cook quinoa separately according to package instructions.
Combine lentils and quinoa in a bowl with sauteed onion and spices.
Top with roasted sweet potato and serve.

title: Veggie Paneer Biryani
description: A fragrant Indian biryani with paneer and vegetables cooked in aromatic basmati rice. Rich in protein and flavor.
instructions: Marinate paneer in yogurt and spices for 15 minutes.
Cook basmati rice until 80% done.
Layer paneer and sauteed vegetables with rice in a pot.
Cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes until fully done.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala Brown Rice
description: Classic restaurant-style chicken tikka masala served with brown rice. High protein and satisfying Indian dinner.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and tandoori spices for 15 minutes and grill.
Saute onion, garlic, and tomatoes with masala spices.
Add grilled chicken to the sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve over brown rice.

title: Beef Enchilada Bowl
description: A hearty Mexican-style beef and bean bowl with enchilada flavors. High protein and calorie-dense for athletes.
instructions: Cook ground beef with onion, cumin, and chili powder.
Add black beans and tomato sauce and simmer.
Serve over brown rice in a bowl.
Top with shredded cheese and avocado.

title: Tofu Vegetable Thai Curry
description: A fragrant Thai-style vegan tofu curry with vegetables. Rich in plant protein and coconut milk fats.
instructions: Fry tofu cubes in coconut oil until golden.
Saute onion, garlic, and curry paste in the same pan.
Add broccoli, bell pepper, and coconut milk.
Simmer for 10 minutes and serve with jasmine rice.

title: Grilled Salmon Asparagus Dinner
description: A classic grilled salmon and asparagus dinner. Loaded with omega-3s and vitamins for recovery.
instructions: Season salmon fillet with olive oil, garlic, and lemon.
Grill salmon for 5 minutes per side.
Roast broccoli and zucchini with olive oil at 200C.
Serve salmon alongside vegetables.

title: Paneer Saag with Millet
description: Creamy spinach-based paneer saag served with protein-rich millet. A nutrient-dense vegetarian Indian dinner.
instructions: Blanch and puree spinach.
Saute onion, garlic, ginger, and spices in oil.
Add paneer cubes and spinach puree and simmer.
Serve with cooked millet.

title: Chicken Thigh Cauliflower Rice Bowl
description: A low-carb chicken thigh bowl with cauliflower rice. Great for body recomposition and fat loss.
instructions: Season chicken thigh and pan-cook until done.
Grate cauliflower and stir-fry briefly as rice substitute.
Serve chicken over cauliflower rice.
Add fresh spinach and lemon on the side.

title: Tuna Pasta Primavera
description: A Mediterranean-style tuna pasta with spring vegetables. Balanced protein and carbs for active individuals.
instructions: Cook whole wheat pasta until al dente.
Saute zucchini, tomato, and garlic in olive oil.
Add drained tuna and pasta and toss together.
Season with salt, pepper, and herbs and serve.

title: Chickpea Lentil Power Salad
description: A filling vegan salad with chickpeas, lentils, and roasted vegetables. Excellent protein and fiber combination.
instructions: Cook lentils until tender and cool.
Drain and rinse chickpeas.
Roast bell pepper and zucchini with olive oil.
Toss all together with lemon dressing and serve.

title: Lamb Brown Rice Pilaf
description: A Middle Eastern-inspired lamb and brown rice pilaf with spices. Protein-dense and aromatic dinner.
instructions: Brown ground beef (lamb-style) with onion and garlic.
Add brown rice, cinnamon, cumin, and broth.
Bring to a boil and simmer covered for 25 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and serve with fresh parsley.

title: Chole Bhature
description: A classic North Indian vegetarian meal of spiced chickpeas with fried bread. High in plant protein and deeply satisfying.
instructions: Saute onion, ginger, garlic, and tomatoes with chole masala.
Add chickpeas and water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook roti in a pan with a small amount of oil.
Serve hot chole with roti.

title: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowl
description: A Japanese teriyaki salmon bowl with brown rice and edamame. Rich in omega-3s and complex carbs.
instructions: Marinate salmon in soy sauce, ginger, and honey.
Bake or pan-cook salmon for 12-15 minutes.
Cook brown rice and prepare a side of steamed broccoli.
Serve salmon over rice with broccoli.

title: Tempeh Quinoa Veggie Bowl
description: A vegan tempeh and quinoa bowl with roasted vegetables. Dense plant protein and complex carbs for muscle building.
instructions: Cook quinoa and set aside.
Pan-fry sliced tempeh until golden.
Roast sweet potato and bell pepper in olive oil.
Assemble bowl with quinoa, tempeh, and roasted vegetables.

title: Paneer Brown Rice Masala Bowl
description: A nourishing Indian vegetarian bowl with masala paneer and brown rice. High protein and fiber-rich.
instructions: Cook brown rice and set aside.
Fry paneer cubes until golden.
Saute onion, tomato, and masala spices.
Add paneer and simmer briefly, then serve over brown rice.

title: Chicken Breast Vegetable Soup
description: A light and nourishing chicken and vegetable soup. High protein and low calorie, perfect for fat loss.
instructions: Dice chicken breast and simmer in broth.
Add carrot, celery, onion, and garlic.
Cook until vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh herbs.

title: Shrimp Fried Cauliflower Rice
description: A low-carb shrimp fried rice made with cauliflower. High protein and vegetable-rich for body recomposition.
instructions: Grate cauliflower into rice-size pieces.
Stir-fry shrimp in a wok with garlic and ginger.
Add cauliflower rice and cook for 5 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and scrambled egg bits.

title: Soy Chunk Rajma Masala
description: A protein-packed vegan combination of soy chunks and kidney beans in masala. Excellent plant protein source.
instructions: Soak and drain soy chunks.
Cook kidney beans or use canned.
Saute onion, tomato, and spices and add both proteins.
Simmer for 15 minutes and serve with brown rice.

title: Egg Fried Rice with Broccoli
description: A quick and satisfying egg fried rice with broccoli. High protein and vegetable-dense vegetarian dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok and scramble eggs, then push aside.
Add cooked brown rice and stir-fry.
Add broccoli florets and cook for 3 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil.

title: Salmon Lentil Power Plate
description: A nutrient-dense plate combining omega-3-rich salmon with lentils. Great for recovery and body recomposition.
instructions: Cook red lentils with onion and spices until thick.
Pan-sear salmon fillet in olive oil.
Serve salmon on a bed of lentils.
Add steamed spinach on the side.

title: Eggplant Chickpea Stew
description: A hearty vegan Middle Eastern stew with eggplant and chickpeas. Filling and rich in plant protein and fiber.
instructions: Cube and roast eggplant with olive oil at 200C for 15 minutes.
Saute onion and garlic, add chickpeas and tomatoes.
Add roasted eggplant and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with cumin, coriander, and serve hot.

title: Turkey Chickpea One-Pan Dinner
description: A simple one-pan dinner with ground turkey and chickpeas. Lean protein and legume combination for athletes.
instructions: Brown turkey in a pan with olive oil and garlic.
Add chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and spices.
Simmer for 15 minutes until flavors meld.
Add spinach at the end, cook until wilted, and serve.

title: Beef Keema Quinoa Bowl
description: A hearty dinner bowl with spiced ground beef keema and quinoa. High in protein and iron for strength athletes.
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in oil.
Add ground beef with garam masala, cumin, and tomato.
Cook until beef is done and sauce thickens.
Serve over cooked quinoa with green peas.

title: Moong Dal Khichdi
description: A comforting Indian vegan one-pot meal with moong dal and rice. Easily digestible and high in plant protein.
instructions: Rinse moong dal and rice together.
Pressure cook with turmeric, cumin, and salt.
Temper with ghee (or coconut oil), mustard seeds, and curry leaves.
Serve hot with yogurt or pickle.

title: Cottage Cheese Spinach Quesadilla
description: A protein-rich vegetarian quesadilla with cottage cheese and spinach. Quick lunch with balanced macros.
instructions: Spread cottage cheese on a whole wheat tortilla.
Add fresh spinach and season with salt and chili flakes.
Fold tortilla in half and cook in a dry pan until golden.
Serve with salsa or yogurt dip.

title: Chicken Taco Salad Bowl
description: A Mexican-inspired chicken taco salad bowl with avocado and beans. High protein and fiber for body recomposition.
instructions: Season and cook chicken breast with taco spices.
Slice chicken over a bed of cabbage.
Add black beans, diced tomato, and avocado.
Drizzle with Greek yogurt and lime juice.

title: Barley Mushroom Risotto
description: A hearty vegan barley mushroom risotto with herbs. Rich in beta-glucans, fiber, and umami flavor.
instructions: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes.
Add barley and broth and simmer for 30 minutes stirring occasionally.
Season with thyme, salt, and fresh parsley.

title: Chicken Quinoa Greek Bowl
description: A Greek-style bowl with grilled chicken, quinoa, and cucumber-tomato salad. Balanced protein and healthy fats.
instructions: Cook quinoa and cool.
Grill chicken breast with olive oil, lemon, and oregano.
Slice chicken and serve over quinoa.
Add diced cucumber, tomato, and a dollop of Greek yogurt.

title: Smoked Mackerel Sweet Potato Mash
description: A rich dinner of smoked mackerel with sweet potato mash. High in omega-3s and beta-carotene.
instructions: Boil or microwave sweet potato until soft.
Mash with a little olive oil and season.
Flake smoked salmon onto the plate alongside mash.
Add steamed spinach on the side and serve.

title: Couscous Roasted Vegetable Salad
description: A vegan couscous salad with roasted Mediterranean vegetables. Light on calories but rich in nutrients.
instructions: Pour boiling water over couscous and leave covered for 5 minutes.
Roast bell pepper, zucchini, and cherry tomatoes with olive oil.
Fluff couscous with a fork and combine with roasted vegetables.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, and fresh herbs.

title: Turkey Barley Stuffed Peppers
description: Bell peppers stuffed with lean turkey and barley. A fiber-rich, protein-dense meal for body recomposition.
instructions: Halve bell peppers and remove seeds.
Cook turkey with onion, garlic, and cooked barley.
Fill peppers and bake at 190C for 25 minutes.
Serve hot with a side salad.

title: Cauliflower Chickpea Tikka
description: A bold vegan tikka with cauliflower and chickpeas in a spiced yogurt marinade. Packed with plant protein.
instructions: Marinate cauliflower florets and chickpeas in spiced tomato paste.
Roast at 220C for 20 minutes until charred.
Serve on a bed of brown rice or with roti.
Garnish with lemon juice and fresh coriander.

title: Cashew Berry Protein Smoothie
description: A creamy vegan smoothie with cashews and mixed berries. Rich in plant protein, antioxidants, and healthy fats.
instructions: Add cashews, berries, and banana to a blender.
Pour in almond milk and blend until smooth.
Add chia seeds and blend for 10 more seconds.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.
